metadata.question: The Landsat 8 satellite captures pictures of active fire in Monte Pisano, Italy on February 25, 2019, around 10:58 a.m. local time. Was the smoke plume moving in an eastern direction?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Monte Pisano, Italy (approximately 43.73°N, 10.56°E) - Date: February 25, 2019 - Collection: Landsat 8 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2) - Time: around 10:58 a.m. local time (need to check available images on this date) 2. Masking strategy: - This question is specifically about smoke plume direction, NOT about masking clouds - We need to visualize/analyze the smoke plume using appropriate bands - Smoke detection can use thermal bands or true color imagery - The question asks about direction of movement - this is a visual/spatial analysis 3. Logic: - Need to find the Landsat 8 image from Feb 25, 2019 - Check if image exists (C1 if not) - Analyze the smoke plume direction using band combinations or thermal data - Smoke plumes can be detected using aerosol bands or thermal anomalies - Direction analysis: check if the plume extends eastward from the fire source - Valid result: A (Yes, moving east) or B (No, not moving east) - C1: No image found - C2: No valid pixels (unlikely for this question) - C3: Cannot determine direction ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Monte Pisano, Italy const montePisano = ee.Geometry.Point([10.56, 43.73]); const region = montePisano.buffer(15000); // 15km buffer for smoke analysis // 2. Define date range for February 25, 2019 const targetDate = '2019-02-25'; const startDate = '2019-02-24'; const endDate = '2019-02-26'; // 3. Load Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level 2 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(montePisano) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const imageCount = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images found: ${imageCount}`); if (imageCount === 0) { console.log("No Landsat 8 images found for February 25, 2019."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Get the image const image = collection.first(); const imageDate = ee.Date(image.get('system:time_start')).format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm').getInfo(); console.log(`Image date: ${imageDate}`); // 5. Analyze smoke plume direction using aerosol band and thermal data // Use SR_B1 (Coastal Aerosol) for smoke detection // Compare pixel intensities in different directions from fire center // Define directional regions from the fire center const fireCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([10.56, 43.73]); const eastRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([10.58, 43.71, 10.68, 43.75]); // East of fire const westRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([10.46, 43.71, 10.54, 43.75]); // West of fire const northRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([10.54, 43.75, 10.58, 43.80]); // North of fire const southRegion = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([10.54, 43.68, 10.58, 43.71]); // South of fire // Use aerosol band (SR_B1) - higher values indicate smoke/aerosols const aerosolBand = image.select('SR_B1'); // Calculate mean aerosol values in each direction const eastMean = aerosolBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: eastRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B1').getInfo(); const westMean = aerosolBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: westRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B1').getInfo(); const northMean = aerosolBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B1').getInfo(); const southMean = aerosolBand.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: southRegion, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B1').getInfo(); console.log(`Aerosol levels - East: ${eastMean}, West: ${westMean}, North: ${northMean}, South: ${southMean}`); if (eastMean === null || westMean === null || northMean === null || southMean === null) { console.log("Cannot calculate aerosol values."); console.log("C3"); return; } // 6. Determine smoke plume direction // If east has significantly higher aerosol than west, smoke is moving east const maxDirection = Math.max(eastMean, westMean, northMean, southMean); console.log(`Maximum aerosol in: ${maxDirection === eastMean ? 'East' : maxDirection === westMean ? 'West' : maxDirection === northMean ? 'North' : 'South'}`); // Smoke plume moving east if eastern aerosol is highest or significantly elevated if (eastMean === maxDirection && eastMean > westMean * 1.1) { console.log("Smoke plume shows eastward movement pattern."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Smoke plume does not show clear eastward movement."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
